userObservation: A reboot booted without mods; asks how Settings Restart can preserve activation
conclusion: Upstream XOVI intentionally returns to stock after an OS reboot. Retained files do not preserve running LD_PRELOAD activation. Automatic mod activation is a separate boot policy, not a Settings checkbox.
observedDeviceEvidence: Full-boot probe107: changed kernel boot ID,54.61s uptime, installed files and complete private-state SHA unchanged, transient Pi Ink unit absent, stock/bridge listeners absent; owner confirms boot without mods.

primarySources.finding: README says reboot returns to stock by design; recommends a separate starter such as xovi-tripletap; explicitly warns against forcing XOVI into encrypted-tablet boot via root-partition xochitl systemd edits because of bootloops.

Power-button starter supports TRIGGER_ACTION=start or toggle; start is default. POST_START_COMMANDS can run commands after XOVI starts. This is manual reactivation, not automatic mod preservation across OS reboot.
Third-party unattended boot autostart is explicitly advanced/experimental and opt-in; claims of crash-loop protection were not verified on this tablet. Do not treat it as an upstream-safe default.

retainedInstallationEvidence.finding: Earlier mod-enabled Xochitl service had LD_PRELOAD=/home/root/xovi/xovi.so and XOVI_ROOT=/home/root/xovi/services/xochitl.service/ in00-xovi.conf. This historical record does not establish the current post-boot service configuration or a currently installed tripletap service.

recommendedConfigurationPlan: Preserve stock OS boot as the recovery path; use supported xovi-tripletap to reactivate mods after reboot without a PC
Verify/install the actual starter before prescribing device-specific configuration; TRIGGER_ACTION=start avoids inadvertently toggling an already modded session off
Use a post-XOVI-start hook for an owned Pi Ink startup wrapper; the current transient unit must be recreated after full boot, not merely started by name as if persistent
Keep firmware and private-stock-listener checks before enabling document operations; retain paired authentication and all existing document/job associations
Do not silently replace full OS reboot with systemctl restart xochitl; that is an application restart, not OS reboot
ifAutomaticActivationIsRequired: A separately approved experimental boot-autostart design would be necessary. Upstream warns against it; never promise safety or firmware-update compatibility. Do not install naive permanent LD_PRELOAD boot drop-ins.
verificationNeeded: Actual full OS boot with changed boot ID
Stock boot remains usable with mods disabled
Supported manual mod-start action restores manager/toolbar without USB
Owned Pi Ink startup recreates only its expected unit and resumes the same paired channel
Private stock listener remains loopback-only, and pending/terminal document states are retained
installedTripletapConfiguration: not inspected by existing approved probes; no claim that it is installed or configured
